scope: Four illustrative measured-derived Small IN100 grain-surface, point-cloud, numeric interchange, and point-to-grid pipelines; occurrences are not independent filter verification. Stages 03 and 04 use complementary tiles and do not claim duplicate-removal coverage.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Complete Grain Surface.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Expose each original FaceLabels component without changing source ownership.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Complete Grain Surface.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Expose each original FaceLabels component without changing source ownership.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Complete Grain Surface.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Retain all grain-2205 faces selected through either original label component and compact vertices.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Complete Grain Surface.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Label the connected extracted shell in a separate local region namespace.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Complete Grain Surface.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Repair the observed inconsistent winding of the single extracted shell.

filters.pipeline: (02) Small IN100 Grain Surface Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Integrate enclosed volume with a local [-1,1] label pair after closure checks.

filters.pipeline: (02) Small IN100 Grain Surface Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Calculate the unique-surface-vertex mean with its actual implementation meaning.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Read four numeric datasets from TileA: 89 XYZ tuples and matching scalar metadata. Declare tuple/component shapes explicitly; no transpose, geometry, units, or NX structure is imported.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Read four numeric datasets from TileB: 81 XYZ tuples and matching scalar metadata. Declare tuple/component shapes explicitly; no transpose, geometry, units, or NX structure is imported.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Append TileA then TileB rows for Coordinates_um: 89 + 81 = 170 tuples. Use the same order for coordinates and every scalar; preserve the input numeric type and component shape.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Append TileA then TileB rows for SourceROICellIndex: 89 + 81 = 170 tuples. Use the same order for coordinates and every scalar; preserve the input numeric type and component shape.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Append TileA then TileB rows for FeatureIds: 89 + 81 = 170 tuples. Use the same order for coordinates and every scalar; preserve the input numeric type and component shape.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Append TileA then TileB rows for Image Quality: 89 + 81 = 170 tuples. Use the same order for coordinates and every scalar; preserve the input numeric type and component shape.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Split all three XYZ coordinate components into scalar columns while retaining Coordinates_um as an inspection checkpoint.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Combine X_um, Y_um, Z_um columns in that exact order into 170 three-component vertices. Keep physical coordinates unchanged: normalization and source removal are disabled.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Move six scalar columns into ReassembledCloud/Vertex Data so each row describes the corresponding vertex. Leave imported tiles and both assembled coordinate arrays as inspection checkpoints.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Export all point tuples, including valid row zero, in an explicit six-column CSV with headers.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Record each source point's containing cell and fail on any out-of-bounds point. GridCellIndex is an ownership/inspection result; Interpolate Point Cloud v4 independently computes its own indices from coordinates.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Average ImageQuality64 only within each containing cell: Uniform kernel size 0.25 micrometers is below 0.5 micrometer spacing, so the integer radius is zero. Contribution counts distinguish observed cells from zero-filled empty cells.

filters.pipeline: (04) Small IN100 Point Cloud Interchange.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Spread ImageQuality64 into a 3 by 3 by 3 grid-cell neighborhood using Gaussian sigma 1 in each axis (one cell offset, or 0.5 micrometers here). Kernel weights use integer cell offsets, not exact point-to-center distances. Positive counts outside observed cells are estimates, not new measurements.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Read stage 01: retain the cropped source image and grain surface as context. Stage 02 is not required.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Index all 24-cubed cropped image cells from 0 to 13823 in flat storage order; this is an ROI-local tuple index, not a global acquisition ID.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Keep the 170 source cells whose original reconstructed FeatureId equals 2205; true means extract.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Extract measured-derived voxel centers and COPY three scalar arrays. These 170 points are distinct from the 256 grain surface vertices.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy ReferenceCloud_Raw coordinates into independent ReferenceCloud with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into ReferenceCloud; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Delete only temporary ReferenceCloud_Raw after coordinates and scalar arrays have been copied into ReferenceCloud.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Create TileA as a complementary spatial tile with 89 points from the same measured-derived reference. The split at X=25.25 micrometers lies between voxel centers; this is not an independent acquisition.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy TileA_Raw coordinates into independent TileA with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into TileA; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Delete only temporary TileA_Raw after coordinates and scalar arrays have been copied into TileA.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Create TileB as a complementary spatial tile with 81 points from the same measured-derived reference. The split at X=25.25 micrometers lies between voxel centers; this is not an independent acquisition.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy TileB_Raw coordinates into independent TileB with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into TileB; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Delete only temporary TileB_Raw after coordinates and scalar arrays have been copied into TileB.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Reassemble the complementary spatial tiles and matching scalar metadata: 89 plus 81 equals 170 unique source-cell centers. No deduplication is performed.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy CombinedTiles_Raw coordinates into independent CombinedTiles with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into CombinedTiles; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Delete only temporary CombinedTiles_Raw after coordinates and scalar arrays have been copied into CombinedTiles.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy CombinedTiles coordinates into independent MovingChallenge with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into MovingChallenge; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Apply the known synthetic challenge to real voxel-center coordinates: rotate 2 degrees about global Z, then translate [1,-0.75,0.5] micrometers. Preserve the challenge separately.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy MovingChallenge coordinates into independent MovingCoarse with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into MovingCoarse; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Translate MovingCoarse so its coordinate-wise minimum matches ReferenceCloud (Origin alignment), providing a close starting pose for local ICP.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Copy MovingCoarse coordinates into independent MovingRegistered with explicit Micrometer units; fresh geometry actions and whole-geometry copies do not preserve the input unit.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Deep-copy all retained scalar metadata into MovingRegistered; keep source-cell identity and inherited image quality unchanged.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Run 10 rigid closest-point iterations from the close origin-aligned pose and apply the residual transform to MovingRegistered. The saved matrix excludes the earlier coarse translation.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Draw 5000 points from the repaired measured-derived grain shell, selecting triangles in proportion to area. Fixed seed 2205 supports repeatable runs in the same implementation. Transfer no face arrays because of issue 1799; this is derived sampling, not new acquisition data.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Publish SurfaceSamples as explicit Micrometer coordinates without rescaling; retain the source geometry calibration when the generating filter defaults its unit metadata.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Remove only temporary SurfaceSamples_Raw after its calibrated geometry and required arrays are retained.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Check that generated SurfaceSamples lie on Grain2205, retaining signed micrometer distances and nearest triangle row IDs. This is a geometric association after sampling; tied boundary triangles need not equal the original random choice.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Approximate the boundary of the 170 measured-derived voxel-center points on a 0.25 micrometer grid. Keep occupied cells with at least one empty 26-neighbor cell and output their point means. This creates unconnected representative points, not a closed mesh.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Publish Hull025um as explicit Micrometer coordinates without rescaling; retain the source geometry calibration when the generating filter defaults its unit metadata.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Remove only temporary Hull025um_Raw after its calibrated geometry and required arrays are retained.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Approximate the boundary of the 170 measured-derived voxel-center points on a 0.5 micrometer grid. Keep occupied cells with at least one empty 26-neighbor cell and output their point means. This creates unconnected representative points, not a closed mesh.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Publish Hull05um as explicit Micrometer coordinates without rescaling; retain the source geometry calibration when the generating filter defaults its unit metadata.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Remove only temporary Hull05um_Raw after its calibrated geometry and required arrays are retained.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Partition source image cells on an explicit 0.5 micrometer grid with bounds [24,25,14] to [26.5,28,17]. SpatialPartitionIds 1..180 describe bins, not grains; zero marks source cells outside this grid. Preserve original FeatureIds. Vertex-mode preflight remains deferred for issue 1798.

filters.pipeline: (03) Small IN100 Grain Point Cloud Registration.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Save source context, complementary calibrated tiles, the reassembled cloud, all three moving checkpoints, and the known and ICP residual transforms.
